description: Hafen Enge is the marina on Mythenquai, in Zurich’s Enge quarter, a stone basin of sailboat masts with the open lake beyond the harbour mouth. The tree-lined quay fills the near shore, and the Alps are only a faint shape under cloud. This is the west-shore harbour, not Bürkliplatz. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and mild, with a light breeze and no rain.
